titles.title: Doing Life
titles.plot: A single mother fighting to survive and a reformed ex-con with untapped talent find in each other an unlikely second chance.

titles.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
titles.plot: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo's ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor.

titles.title: In Spite of Ourselves
titles.plot: Love comes easy -- relationships don't. When Hannah, a warm and determined Portland, OR baker, crosses paths with Archie, an up-and-coming LA comedian with a habit of dodging commitment, their instant chemistry sparks a whirlwind romance neither expected. But after two blissful weeks together, real life pulls them back to separate cities, forcing them to confront distance, doubts, and their own hilariously messy insecurities. Heartfelt, funny, and deeply relatable, IN SPITE OF OURSELVES follows two imperfect people trying to figure out whether they can move past their fears -- and give love a real chance.

titles.title: Love of Your Life
titles.plot: Directed by Rachel Morrison (The Fire Inside), LOVE OF YOUR LIFE follows Maya (Margaret Qualley), whose chance encounter with Charlie (Gabriel Basso) sets in motion a sweeping romance and a future beyond anything she had imagined. When that future is suddenly upended, Maya is sent hurtling toward an unexpected new life--one that will force her to reckon with who she is, what she wants, and how to love again.

titles.title: Sense and Sensibility
titles.plot: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen's iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

titles.title: The Love Hypothesis
titles.plot: Based on the New York Times best-selling novel by Ali Hazelwood, The Love Hypothesis follows Olive (Lili Reinhart), a brilliant Ph.D. candidate focused on her future in academia. But when she realizes her best friend Anh (Rachel Marsh) has fallen for her crush Jeremy (Nicholas Duvernay), Olive impulsively kisses intimidating professor Adam Carlsen (Tom Bateman) to prove she’s moved on. What begins as a desperate act of friendship spirals into a fake relationship with rules, boundaries, and a mutually beneficial agreement. When their arrangement begins to blur the lines between performance and reality, Olive is forced to test her most daunting hypothesis yet: that love might actually be worth the risk.

titles.title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
titles.original_title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
titles.plot: In Tyler Perry's "Why Did I Get Married Again?", the couples reunite in celebration as Marcus and Angela's daughter prepares to tie the knot. After being apart for quite some time, they learn quickly that as much as things change, they stay the same. Realizing their children have grown up to be so much like them, they must reflect on the examples they've set and ask themselves that age-old question, why did they get married... again?

titles.title: You+Me - Against the World
titles.plot: Alma Lancaster (Vittoria Di Savoia), 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi (Lucas Barski), 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love -- despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.
